payload.content: Referral to Endocrinology for evaluation and management of type 2 diabetes mellitus. Patient is a male aged 50–64 currently taking metformin 500 mg, with comorbid hypertension treated with lisinopril 10 mg and hyperlipidemia treated with atorvastatin 20 mg. Please assess glycemic control, review renal function and diabetes-related complications, and provide recommendations regarding medication optimization, cardiovascular risk reduction, and routine monitoring.
